title: Keep Binance XRP withdrawal status unconfirmed; quarantine remaining scheduled issue and metrics writers as next safety priority
context: XRP Insights' latest accessible pinned ledger remains 108037957 at 04:35 UTC and reports 1B XRP released, zero re-escrow by that ledger, destination and later disposition unknown.
Binance Update #4 reports 95% aggregate replenishment and includes XRP among ten assets claimed 100% backed; full cryptographic proof and liability reconciliation remain pending.
The 06:00–09:00 UTC phase-one window includes XRP and is progressive. The 06:10 UTC network-status recheck still displayed No records; actual XRP availability remains unknown.
PR #1443 passed 349 tests + 8 subtests and gate; PR #1444 passed 363 + 8 and gate; PR #1445 passed 346 + 8 and gate. All remain open/draft/unmerged.
Main remains at 694fc424. Scheduled issue-mutating workflows and the Gumroad metrics main writer remain active outside the current safety proposals.

decisions.decision: Retain XRP escrow event as tracker-reported 1B gross release at ledger 108037957/04:35 UTC; destination and later disposition remain unknown.
decisions.reason: No raw transaction metadata or later destination flows were independently decoded.

decisions.decision: Classify Binance XRP withdrawal availability as UNCONFIRMED at 06:15 UTC.
decisions.reason: The official announcement describes progressive phase-one inclusion; the live status page exposes no asset-level rows.

decisions.decision: Do not admit escrow or Binance withdrawal schedule as a directional feature; require actual service activation and successful withdrawal transaction evidence.
decisions.reason: Scheduled windows and page-render gaps are not completed flows.

decisions.decision: Keep PRs #1443, #1444 and #1445 draft/unmerged pending explicit user approval.
decisions.reason: Exact-head CI and fail-closed gates are necessary evidence but do not authorize merge.

decisions.decision: Prioritize scheduled issue-mutating and metrics workflows as the next repository safety batch.
decisions.reason: These workflows create/close/assign issues or write metrics to main on schedules without a per-run user confirmation.

decisions.decision: Do not claim live Copilot collaboration from the AUTO_ASSIGNEE variable reference.
decisions.reason: The configured value and actual authenticated handoff are unverified.

decisions.decision: Retain the current zero-job approval-workflow classification as an expected unmatched push event because the workflow is workflow_dispatch-only.
decisions.reason: No approval job is expected on push; this is not a failed manual approval execution.

decisions.decision: Treat SBI Holdings, Circle SBI Japan K.K. and the regional Japanese SBIC investment corporations as separate legal/entity nodes.
decisions.reason: Name similarity is insufficient to infer ownership or partnership; official corporate profiles and filings distinguish them.

decisions.decision: Classify SBI's current network as multi-rail and multi-partner, not as an exclusive XRP strategy.
decisions.reason: SBI has documented links to Ripple/XRP and to Circle, JPYSC, SMFG, BlackRock, Startale and Open Standard/OUSD; no integrated XRP routing mandate is disclosed.

decisions.decision: Do not infer native XRP demand from JPYSC, OUSD, Circle USDC or RLUSD issuance/settlement without a demonstrated XRP bridge, collateral or inventory transaction.
decisions.reason: Stablecoin supply and XRPL activity are not equivalent to native XRP purchases.

decisions.decision: Do not claim material Coinbase XRP collateral from the Q3 2026 10-Q; classify XRP-specific collateral as undisclosed.
decisions.reason: The filing does not separately name XRP; BTC, ETH and aggregate other-crypto lines are reported.

decisions.decision: Keep ETF holdings deltas, USD cash-flow trackers and fund AUM separate; reconcile fund universes before computing actual capital.
decisions.reason: XRP Insights, Maketo and SoSoValue have different fund coverage and methods.

decisions.decision: Do not create a unified XRP open-interest value from current provider snapshots.
decisions.reason: Provider universes range from seven contracts to 26 exchanges including CME and produce materially different totals.

decisions.decision: Keep Binance XRP withdrawal availability UNCONFIRMED until a live status row or successful customer withdrawal transaction is observed.
decisions.reason: The official phase-one window is announced, but the status page is stale and contains no asset-level data.

decisions.decision: Keep the prediction engine in research-only mode; no market features or directional forecast admitted from this snapshot.
decisions.reason: Data-source coverage, timestamp and causal uncertainties remain material.

decisions.decision: PR #1446 is a tested safety proposal, not an active main-branch remediation; do not merge without explicit approval.
decisions.reason: Exact-head CI and fail-closed gate establish proposal quality, not deployment authorization.

required_features: successful withdrawal timestamps and ledger hashes
withdrawal_event_study.sale_inference_rule: Withdrawal is not sale; require exchange deposit attribution and trade/flow evidence.

ingestion_contract.feature_admission: No directional feature until source coverage, timestamp alignment, transaction-level evidence and missingness checks pass.
ingestion_contract.prediction_contract: Every forecast records target, horizon, data cutoff, assumptions, probability/confidence, alternatives, baseline, model version, calibration and later outcome.
ingestion_contract.live_trading: Shadow/paper only until leakage-safe walk-forward skill and calibration are independently reviewed.

platform_coordination.rule: No live collaboration claim without successful least-privilege authentication and a tested structured handoff.
